interpretation: A parameter-free last-reported-state baseline is extremely strong at 1 s and degrades monotonically with forecast horizon. At 1 s it is slightly better than the fitted G1 prior model on row-weighted MAE (G1: 0.16714 valence, 0.18611 arousal), so model novelty must not be claimed; the scientific question is incremental information beyond a strong persistence benchmark. Longer-horizon comparison awaits the frozen G2 fitted models.
firewall: Diagnostic benchmark only; no physiology, causal, or phenomenal inference.
